lastCompletedStory.title: Route append/dismiss/promote pen writers through per-attempt recompute

nextStoryContext: appendSuggestionOnMain/dismissSuggestionOnMain/promoteSuggestionOnMain (src/commands/suggestions.ts) now pass a FileWritesFn/extraFiles callback (US-001, CAM-300 primitive) instead of a whole-file FileWrite computed once from the pre-mutation read: each callback re-invokes readPenContentFromMain and re-runs the same pure dedup/removal logic (append's new buildAppendedContent helper; dismiss/promote's existing removeSuggestionLine keyed by fingerprint) against the fresh content on every CAS attempt. The up-front (pre-loop) pen read is intentionally KEPT for the early-exit paths that must fire with NO commit at all (append's already-present dedup skip, dismiss/promote's not-found guard) -- only the whole-file rewrite passed into the writer became per-attempt. promoteSuggestionOnMain's CAM-290 atomic single-commit design is unchanged (pen-removal callback + issue-JSON write still land in the SAME winning attempt's hashAndIndexFiles call). This was the LAST story in the CAM-300 PRD per prd.json (only US-001 + US-002 existed); if the PRD is otherwise complete, the next agent should check for PRD_COMPLETE rather than assuming a US-003 exists. Test pattern established for CAS-retry-with-content-drift regression tests: a fake SpawnFn that fails update-ref exactly once and returns DIFFERENT git show main:<path> content from the 3rd show-call onward (1st = up-front read, 2nd = losing attempt's per-attempt read, 3rd+ = winning attempt's per-attempt read), asserting the LAST hash-object input (not the 1st) carries the concurrently-added/removed line -- reusable for any future on-main whole-file writer needing the same regression coverage.
